title: Tag Team
description:
Deal 11 damage.
The next Attack another player plays on the enemy is played an extra time.
upgraded_description:
Deal 15 damage.
The next Attack another player plays on the enemy is played an extra time.
notes: Multiplayer only card. Applies Tag Team power to the target enemy, which causes the next Attack another player plays on that enemy to be played an extra time and is then removed.
